literal: To those who elevate their family, there is no proper season; if they practice sloth and consider their pride, it will be ruined.
translation: For those who strive to elevate their family, there is no set season for work; if they indulge in laziness and worry about their personal dignity, their family will go to ruin.
modern: தங்கள் குடும்பத்தை உயரச் செய்ய உழைப்பவர்களுக்குக் குறிப்பிட்ட காலம் என்று எதுவும் இல்லை; அவர்கள் சோம்பல் பட்டுக்கொண்டு, தங்கள் மானத்தைப் பற்றி கவலைப்பட்டுக் கொண்டிருந்தால் குடும்பம் அழிந்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes that uplifting one's family requires constant, selfless effort. Those who are committed to this task cannot wait for a convenient time or a favorable season (paruvam) to act. If they succumb to laziness (mati) or hesitate out of concern for their personal pride and status (manam), their noble purpose will fail and the family will decline. Therefore, overcoming sloth and ego is essential for the welfare of one's lineage.
